$comment: The colour roles of a panel (the one-panel spec, §7.10): every colour a panel description makes a surface draw, named once here under the console's token names, each with its family (omx look §2(i): theme, accent, fixed, state), the floor its value must clear against the grounds it is drawn on, and ONE default value. The defaults are the vintage look `look` names (the console's default: dark, orange, aluminium, vintage), each the value the console's tokens.css resolves for that token at that look; tools/look.mjs derives tools/look.json from them, the one public source of the vintage tokens, which the MOD GUI wears, the renderer reads when its host passes no look, the Zynthian UI and its pixel test map their colours from, and the console's sheet is held to. A host that values the roles itself values every one: a look that lacks a role is refused by the role's name, and no role stands in for another. A ground carries no floor: it is what the others are measured on. The knob's pointer and a curve's stroke are roles of their own, never drawn in --accent. Finish and selection colours (knob and fader-cap metal, slot, fill, glass grid, focus ring, shade, selected) are a host's chrome and not roles.

roles.name: --surface
roles.draws: the panel's face

roles.name: --surface-2
roles.draws: a section on the face

roles.name: --surface-3
roles.draws: a control's body: a switch track, a selector, a curve's frame

roles.name: --glass
roles.draws: the recessed glass a display and a meter sit behind

roles.name: --border
roles.draws: a hairline rim

roles.name: --border-strong
roles.draws: the face's rim, a control's rim, a curve's axis

roles.name: --ink
roles.draws: a value, a selected option, a mark and its letter

roles.name: --ink-dim
roles.draws: a label, a section title, a caption

roles.name: --ink-faint
roles.draws: a graticule's numbers and a decoration, never a word that must be read

roles.name: --legend
roles.draws: the silkscreen: a scale's legend printed on the face or the glass

roles.name: --accent
roles.draws: everything live: a fill, a lit switch, a spectrum's trace, a time response's stems, the head line

roles.name: --knob-pointer
roles.draws: a knob's pointer: the line from the knob's centre toward its rim that shows the value

roles.name: --curve-stroke
roles.draws: a curve's stroke: the line through the points of an eq_response, a transfer_curve or a time_response display

roles.name: --meter-green
roles.draws: a meter's safe zone

roles.name: --meter-amber
roles.draws: a meter's caution zone

roles.name: --meter-red
roles.draws: a meter's top zone

roles.name: --eq-delta-boost
roles.draws: the EQ delta view's boost between the pre and post traces

roles.name: --eq-delta-cut
roles.draws: the EQ delta view's cut between the pre and post traces

roles.name: --state-engaged
roles.draws: the lamp of an engaged processor

roles.name: --state-reduction
roles.draws: gain reduction and clip, one red

roles.name: --state-bypass
roles.draws: the picture of a bypassed processor

roles.name: --origin-fbs
roles.draws: the mark of a band the feedback corrector planted (both pools, told apart by shape)

roles.name: --origin-hrp
roles.draws: the mark of a band the harmonic resonance planter planted

roles.name: --origin-room-mode
roles.draws: the mark of a band the room-mode planter planted
